starters.name: Central Park temperature
starters.summary: Two years of real NOAA daily maximum temperature at Central Park. The sample model forecasts the next week.
starters.source: Daily maximum temperature in °C at Central Park, NOAA GHCNd USW00094728, 2024-11-01 through 2026-10-31 (the latest 730 continuous days in the 2024-01-01 to 2026-10-31 download). Public-domain U.S. government work.

starters.name: AAPL daily return
starters.summary: Recent AAPL daily log returns. The starter model forecasts the next return on this sample.
starters.source: Daily log return of AAPL from the public Yahoo Finance chart API. The sample is the latest 180 sessions in that download.

starters.name: Bitcoin daily return
starters.summary: Recent BTCUSDT daily log returns. The starter model forecasts the next return on this sample.
starters.source: Daily log return of BTCUSDT from the public Binance vision kline API. The sample is the latest 180 completed daily closes.

starters.name: Near-Earth approaches
starters.summary: Real JPL close-approach counts for the year beginning 2026-10-22, with the closest catalogued objects in that window.
starters.source: Daily count of catalogued Earth approaches within 0.05 AU, from the committed JPL snapshot, 2026-10-22 through 2027-10-21. These are predicted approaches of objects known when the snapshot was saved.

starters.name: Moon illumination
starters.summary: Computed moon illumination for 180 days. Predict the next fraction from the sample.
starters.source: Moon illumination fraction at 12:00 UTC, computed by src.data.lunar for the 180 days ending 2026-10-01.
